screenshotPrompts.label: Bienvenida
screenshotPrompts.screenDescription: Welcome carousel on cream parchment with progress card 'Tu Progreso' showing 10 de 48 answered, gold-ringed medallion with brown spiral logo, serif title 'Mi Historia, Mi Legado', voice and language pills top right, 'Continuar mi Historia' button.
screenshotPrompts.prompt: Warm heirloom mood: parchment and walnut tones with gold accents. The welcome screen that reassures an elderly user the app will help them preserve their life story for grandchildren.

screenshotPrompts.label: Pregunta con voz
screenshotPrompts.screenDescription: Question screen with banner 'Registrando la historia y legado de María Elena García', question card in serif, Escribir/Grabar mode pills, a typed memory answer in the editor, optional photo section and gold progress bar.
screenshotPrompts.prompt: Intimate, respectful mood: a large readable question card on parchment showing that answers can be typed or recorded by voice. Feel of a gentle interview with a beloved elder.

screenshotPrompts.label: Revisar respuestas
screenshotPrompts.screenDescription: Review screen titled 'Tus Respuestas' listing answered questions grouped by category with saved answers and gold accents, and a 'Crear Libro del Legado' button at the bottom.
screenshotPrompts.prompt: Proud legacy mood: the elder sees their memories organized like a manuscript, warm serif typography, walnut and gold.

screenshotPrompts.label: Libro del Legado
screenshotPrompts.screenDescription: Book creation screen headed 'Crear tu Libro del Legado' with its subtitle and the 'Resumen de tu historia' summary card (preguntas respondidas 10/48, categorías, fotos).
requiredLabels: Criar o seu Livro do Legado
screenshotPrompts.prompt: Celebratory heirloom mood: the promise of a finished vintage PDF book with cover, chapters and photos to hand to the family.
